content.text: {"utterance": "Sam, you ask whether predicting, locating and repairing are one skill or three, and you would plant a flaw where she says she relies on her notes. Now the chatbot. It explains fluently and answers follow-ups, and we have only the conversation. It could pass your locating test if we plant a flaw in text it has just produced. So what exactly would that show, and what inference about learning stays unwarranted? Each of you, name one observation that conversation alone cannot give.", "cites": ["SO1", "SO2"], "memory": "Pressed Sam on whether predicting, locating and repairing are separable, then turned to the chatbot. Live question: what observation beyond conversation would license saying it learned, and what does the final round leave undecided?"}
